rows.note: Not a proxy defect: a recording middleware mounted before the proxy never saw these requests, so TinyHttpd answers 501 itself before dispatch for 'chunked, chunked' and two 'chunked' lines (no backend connection). The proxy check gives 400 for the same headers through the in-memory adapter (ProxyRequestFramingTest AC-3 tests). Status on the default TinyHttpd stack is the adapter's choice; owner is the TinyHttpd adapter framing (FR-ENGINE-003 / engine-adapter scope), not SEC-PROXY-003, whose implementation notes accept adapter-first answers.

rows.note: Not a proxy defect: for HTTP/1.0 with 'Transfer-Encoding: gzip, chunked' TinyHttpd answers 400 before dispatch (recording middleware never reached), while HTTP/1.1 reaches the proxy and gets 501. AC-7 binds the proxy to the headers the adapter reports, and PRD-68 leaves HTTP/1.0 Transfer-Encoding handling to the adapter; owner is the TinyHttpd adapter (engine-adapter scope). The proxy's own version independence is green through the in-memory adapter (ProxyRequestFramingTest AC-7).
